techStack: React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6, Vitest 3 with jsdom + @testing-library/react
noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters are enabled — _onChange aliases must be fully removed, not just unused
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use 'import type'
Vitest globals enabled (describe/it/expect available without imports); setup file at tests/setup.ts
No state management library — React built-in hooks only
ESM-first project; coverage scoped to src/utils/productFilters.ts (primary unit-tested util)
features: filterProducts(products, _filters) is a stub: parameter aliased _filters, body returns unmodified array with 4 TODO comments — all filtering and sorting unimplemented
FilterPanel: onChange prop aliased as _onChange (unused); all 4 handlers (search input, category select, checkbox, Clear button) are empty () => {} stubs; UI renders correctly but nothing responds
SortSelect: onChange prop aliased as _onChange (unused); <select onChange> is () => {} stub; value is controlled but immutable from user perspective
App.tsx: already derives categories via useMemo as ['All', ...unique categories from products] — req 11 is pre-existing and satisfied
App.tsx: passes setFilters directly to FilterPanel (no setPage(1) wrapper) and an inline sort setter to SortSelect (also no setPage(1)) — req 10 needs wrapper addition
useProductFilters.ts: fully implemented — exposes filters, setFilters, products, isLoading, error, page, totalPages, setPage; clearFilters resets to initialFilters; must not regress
FilterState type: { search: string; category: string; inStockOnly: boolean; sortBy: 'default'|'price-asc'|'price-desc'|'rating-desc' } — already defined, no changes needed
architecture: Prop drilling only — no Context API or global store; all state flows from useProductFilters hook → App → components
filterProducts is a pure utility called in App's useMemo; filtering/sorting logic belongs only in src/utils/productFilters.ts
Pagination reset belongs in App.tsx as a wrapper around setFilters calls (per req 10), NOT as a useEffect in the hook
Hybrid fetch model: server-side pagination (page → API) + client-side filter/sort (filterProducts runs on current page's products) — this is by design
All 4 files requiring changes (productFilters.ts, FilterPanel.tsx, SortSelect.tsx, App.tsx) are isolated with no circular dependencies
Tests render bare <App /> with no wrapper providers; default fetch mock returns all 15 products as totalPages=1; tests await results-count before interacting
edgeCases: Empty or whitespace-only search: filters.search.trim() === '' — all products pass; must trim before matching
Whitespace search like ' mouse ': trim() normalizes to 'mouse' before case-insensitive includes() check
filters.category === 'All': bypass category filter entirely, do not compare against product.category
filters.inStockOnly === false: all products pass regardless of inStock field
filters.sortBy === 'default': preserve original filtered order — no sort applied
Input array must not be mutated by sort: spread or slice before calling .sort() on the filtered result
Sort applied after all filters: filter chain runs first, then sort on the filtered subset only
Clear filters resets sortBy to 'default' along with search/'All'/false — the default FilterState object must include sortBy: 'default'
Pagination page must reset to 1 on every filter change AND every sort change — both FilterPanel onChange and SortSelect onChange wrappers in App.tsx must call setPage(1)
noUnusedParameters TSC flag: once _onChange is renamed to onChange and used, the alias is removed and TS compilation passes; leaving _onChange unused after wiring would be a TS error

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1–4: filterProducts filters by name (case-insensitive, trimmed), by category (exact match, 'All' = no filter), by inStockOnly (boolean toggle), and sorts by price-asc/price-desc/rating-desc/default — without mutating the input array
tasks.description: Implement the body of filterProducts in productFilters.ts: (1) filter by search using products whose name.toLowerCase().includes(filters.search.trim().toLowerCase()), skipping when trim is empty; (2) filter by category with exact match, skipping when category is 'All'; (3) filter by inStock when inStockOnly is true; (4) copy the filtered array and sort by price ascending, price descending, rating descending, or return unsorted for 'default'. Rename the _filters parameter to filters.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 5–8: FilterPanel onChange handlers for search input, category select, in-stock checkbox, and Clear filters button must call the onChange prop with updated FilterState; onChange prop must no longer be aliased as _onChange
tasks.description: In FilterPanel.tsx: rename _onChange to onChange in the destructured props. Wire search <input onChange> to call onChange({ ...filters, search: e.target.value }). Wire category <select onChange> to call onChange({ ...filters, category: e.target.value }). Wire in-stock <input type='checkbox' onChange> to call onChange({ ...filters, inStockOnly: e.target.checked }). Wire Clear filters <button onClick> to call onChange({ search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false, sortBy: 'default' }).

tasks.requirement: Requirement 9: SortSelect onChange must call the onChange prop with the selected sortBy value; onChange prop must no longer be aliased as _onChange
tasks.description: In SortSelect.tsx: rename _onChange to onChange in the destructured props. Wire the <select onChange> to call onChange(e.target.value as FilterState['sortBy']).

tasks.requirement: Requirement 10: App.tsx must pass wrapper functions to FilterPanel's onChange and SortSelect's onChange that call both setFilters and setPage(1), not setFilters directly
tasks.description: In App.tsx: replace the direct setFilters passed to FilterPanel's onChange with a wrapper: (nextFilters) => { setFilters(nextFilters); setPage(1); }. Replace the inline sort arrow passed to SortSelect's onChange with a wrapper: (sortBy) => { setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, sortBy })); setPage(1); }.
